_comment: ONLY what Xero cannot know. The roster itself is built at run time from
Xero inventory items, payroll employees and repeating bills - see
src/roster.py. Nobody has to be added here to be found.
Keyed on the inventory item code, because that is the one stable key. A
person's name arrives as 'Dat Le', 'Dat Tien Le' and 'Le, Dat'; matching
on a name once split one contractor into two and moved $60,000.
folder   - where their files already live on OneDrive, when it does NOT
match <client>_<item name>. Ten years of folders carry typos
('Deepati Bansal') and the misspelling is load-bearing: correct
it here and every existing file stops matching. Fix it in
OneDrive first if you want it fixed, then here.
name     - the person as everyone refers to them, where the Xero item name
cadence  - 'monthly' for the offshore team. Default is fortnightly.
emails   - a personal address they also send from. Never required: the
address is read for their name before this is consulted.
contact_names - an extra trading name to match, where the repeating bill
